Author:     Tian Pan <QA_PRIVATE_VALUE_REDACTED>

Commit:     Tian Pan <QA_PRIVATE_VALUE_REDACTED>
CommitDate: Fri Oct 16 22:48:37 2026 -0700

    fix(operator): native Ruby builds and runs Rails in production by default (w8/114)
    
    Render sets RAILS_ENV=production for Ruby services at build and runtime;
    bex set nothing, so an ordinary `bin/rails server` booted in development,
    which binds localhost only: no readiness probe or request ever reached
    it and the deploy never went Live.
    
    Primary Ruby images now carry ENV RAILS_ENV=production before the build
    RUN, beside Elixir's MIX_ENV default: the env loader exports the
    service's own value over it for the build and container configuration
    overrides it at runtime, an explicit empty value included. No binding
    flag, port, probe or app change. The "ruby" runtime key becomes the
    nativeRubyRuntime constant.
    
    Verified: placement on every Ruby line (selected through .ruby-version,
    asserting the resolved base) and for an explicit Ruby static build; a
    BuildKit gate running a real Rails 8.0.4/Puma app through
    `bin/rails server`, built and serving in production on the container's
    own address by default and on loopback only (connection refused on the
    container address) when RAILS_ENV is development or empty; fail-before
    (build unset, every case development). The Python and Ruby gates share
    runServing.
    
    Board: implemented; parked in blocked/ for the hosted replay.
